+"""Directed residual transport objective for paired representations."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute the frozen directed transport and codeword-separation objective."""
+    beta = parameters.get("beta", 0.25)
+    delta = parameters.get("delta", 0.1)
+    tau = parameters.get("tau", 0.1)
+    w = parameters.get("w", 0.001)
+    xi = parameters.get("xi", 0.001)
+
+    # Assignment is intentionally discrete and stop-gradient; selected embeddings
+    # remain live so the objective updates both the inputs and the codebook.
+    source_dist = (source[:, None, :] - codebook[None, :, :]).square().sum(-1)
+    target_dist = (target[:, None, :] - codebook[None, :, :]).square().sum(-1)
+    k = source_dist.detach().argmin(dim=1)
+    ell = target_dist.detach().argmin(dim=1)
+    c_source = codebook[k]
+    c_target = codebook[ell]
+
+    source_error = (source - c_source).square().sum(dim=-1)
+    target_error = (target - c_target).square().sum(dim=-1)
+    h = torch.sigmoid((source_error - target_error) / tau)
+    residual_shift = (target - c_target) - (source - c_source)
+    transport = ((c_source - source) - beta * h[:, None] * residual_shift).square().sum(-1)
+    separation = F.relu(delta ** 2 - (c_source - c_target).square().sum(-1))
+    valid = mask.to(dtype=source.dtype, device=source.device)
+    return w * (valid * h * transport).mean() + xi * (valid * h * separation).mean()
